facts.text: Audrey mentions that the two dogs cuddle up together, especially when it's time to nap.

evidence.quote: Yeah, they always sleep like that. They cuddle up together, especially when it's time to nap.

facts.text: Audrey states that the dogs are always there for each other and that seeing them together makes her happy.

evidence.quote: Yeah, they're always there for each other. Seeing them together makes me so happy.

facts.text: Audrey refers to the dogs as 'furry friends' who keep each other company.

evidence.quote: It must be great having furry friends to keep each other company.

facts.text: Audrey indicates that the dogs mean the world to her and that she cannot imagine life without them.

evidence.quote: Yeah they mean the world to me, so I can't imagine life without them.
